newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil gains with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil gains with futures.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil markets were firmer on Monday alongside firmer futures but business was scant, traders said.
Cargoes were assessed at around $145 a tonne fob NWE.
At least four Russian cargoes were seen available in early November. But dealers said they thought quantities would tail off in the second decade of the month.
A U.K. utility bought a small top-up Russian piece on Friday at a 50 cent premium to the mean of means of published quotes. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
